title: Dino Configuration
description: Configuration for .dino.yml — the Dino API quality scanner.

endpoint.description: Direct API endpoint URL for ad-hoc scans. Omit when using tenant.

protocol.description: API protocol. Only GraphQL is supported currently.

format.description: Output format. JSON is machine-readable; markdown is human-readable.

snapshotDir.description: Directory for schema snapshots (used by dino diff).

aiKey.description: API key for AI reasoning features (Pro tier). Also reads DINO_AI_KEY env var.

level.description: Shadow Mode autonomy level for dino watch.

enabled.description: Enable authenticated scans. Required for RBAC testing.

burst.description: Rate limit burst size override. Free: 10, Pro: 50, Team: 100.
